fields.subject: ArgentSeaSiloBuilderExtensions
fields.trigger: a caller invokes either grain-storage registration family on an ISiloBuilder with a provider name
fields.response: configure the builder's service collection to register the corresponding database or Shard grain-storage factory under that provider name and return the builder; when the caller supplies a persistence-options action, apply it to the options registered under that same provider name before the storage registration is added
